About this item

  • FIND YOUR ITEMS ON FIND MY — AirTag (2nd generation) helps you keep track of what matters. Attach one to an item you want to keep track of using the Find My app.*
  • EXPANDED PRECISION FINDING ON IPHONE AND APPLE WATCH — Get step-by-step directions to your lost item on iPhone and, now, Apple Watch.*
  • ENHANCED SPEAKER — With a 50% louder speaker and a new, distinctive chime, it’s easier than ever to hear and find AirTag.*
  • PING FROM FAR AND WIDE — Upgraded Ultra Wideband and Bluetooth chips allow you to find your items from even farther away than ever before.*
  • SHARE ITEM LOCATION — Share AirTag location access temporarily and securely with trusted contacts, third parties, or over 50 airline partners if you lose something important.
  • BATTERY LIFE — AirTag (2nd generation) works for more than a year on a standard battery you can easily replace when your iPhone alerts you.*
  • SAFE, SOUND, FOUND — Only you or authorized users can see your AirTag location, and your location data and history are never stored on AirTag itself.
  • MORE SUSTAINABLE DESIGN — The latest AirTag features 85% recycled plastic in the enclosure and 100% fiber-based packaging.*
  • LEGAL DISCLAIMERS — *Expanded Precision Finding and louder speaker reflect comparison with previous-generation AirTag. Find My requires iOS 14, iPadOS, or macOS Catalina or later and that your device is signed in to iCloud with your Apple Account. Some features are not available in all countries or regions. Improved Precision Finding works with AirTag (2nd generation) paired with iPhone Air or iPhone 15 or later (excluding iPhone 16e); availability varies by region. Precision Finding on Apple Watch requires an Apple Watch Series 9, or later, or Apple Ultra 2, or later, with watchOS 26.2.1.
  • LEGAL DISCLAIMERS — Battery testing conducted by Apple in December 2025 using preproduction AirTag (2nd generation) units and software paired with iPhone 17, iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max, and iPhone Air units running preproduction software. Battery life based on everyday average usage of playing sound and Precision Finding. Battery life varies with usage, environmental conditions, replacement battery manufacturer, and many other factors; actual results will vary. More sustainable design based on retail packaging as shipped by Apple. Breakdown of U.S. retail packaging by weight. Adhesives, inks, and coatings are excluded from calculations of plastic content and packaging weight.

    Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    AMAZING INVESTMENT! Peace of mind!
    I got an AirTag to replace my tile. AirTags don’t have their own GPS, they use nearby iPhones to anonymously report their location to Apple’s Find My network. Since I’m in NYC, there are iPhones everywhere, so my AirTag’s location is updated constantly no matter how far away I am. If you live somewhere more rural or isolated, updates may be less frequent because there are fewer Apple devices nearby to relay its location. But I have had 0 issues with location, and the location has been MORE accurate than my Tile. Setup was SUPER easy, remove the plastic pull tag and hold the AirTag near your phone, your phone will automatically detect it and prompt you to set it up. It’s small and sleek, smaller than the tile for sure. The ease of use if my favorite feature. The reason I replaced the tile is because you can ONLY ring the tile. However if the keys were tucked away somewhere where the speaker was covered, you couldn’t hear the noise. That’s why I love apples find my tracking feature. It will show you exactly how far you are from your keys as well as what direction they are in. It’s even capable of recognizing that the keys may even be on another floor. Overall I’m so happy with this purchase. It works better than any other tracker I’ve used. I want to get another one to keep into my car so I can find where I parked after a night of bar hopping lol.

      AirTag (Gen 2) 2x Louder, 30% Thinner, 50% Longer. Too good to be true?
      Reviewed in the United States on February 25, 2026
      Style: 1 Pack
      Verified Purchase

      In depth review below summary -

      TLDR (too long, didn’t read summary)

      I didn’t think the AirTag had many ways to be improved, realistically, without a higher price point. Apple delivered all their promises though with this AirTag (2nd generation) that is more than 2x louder, 30% thinner (and lighter), while using 50% less battery.

      With AirTag, Apple has fixed the lost dog problem and made it so we never have to lose our keys again; the days of needing to go to the DMV to replace my lost license are in the past. Join the revolution, get your hands on AirTags! - Recommended for iPhone users, Android users look into if trackers are made by their phone’s manufacturer.

      In Depth Product Review:

      01. Sound test.

      Strong pass, although it honestly sounds more like 2.5-3 times as loud as my 1st gen AirTag (about 8 months old with a brand new battery). This shocked me, as the original never felt too silent by any means.

      02. Battery life.

      We’ll see - if Apple’s telling the truth. It’ll be years before we know with a new device that uses such a small amount of power. But yes, I’d love to have to only replace the battery every other year rather than every 10-13 months as I get with OG AirTag.

      00. New to AirTag? Curious about using it?

      I take for granted how much I use AirTags and how reliable they are for making my belongings secure providing true peace of mind at some could-have-been-horrible moments. Lost dog? Laptop Backpack? Wallet? Keys? These moments used to make me tremble with anxiety, not knowing how much time it will take to replace the item.

      Now I simply open the “Find My” app and click the item (or puppy) and see (with impressive precision) an arrow that points in the direction of my AirTag and displays # of feet away the item is from you. You move? The arrow and distance change instantly. The item moves? Same thing. I can’t see it? I tap on ring item and even buried under a foot of dirt would hear the new, incredibly impressive speakers.

      Apple has fixed the lost dog problem and made it so we never have to lose our keys again; the days of needing to go to the DMV to replace a lost license are in the past for me. Join the revolution, get your AirTag’s today!

      Comparisons to similar products:

      There’s no way to disconnect or need to drown your battery life with location always being shared and Bluetooth always being connected to a device. Unlike all of the new Bluetooth often labelled “Apple Find My Supported” Bluetooth trackers in wallets and key fobs are all awful and any modern day tracker that’s using ancient (40 year old Bluetooth technology) made by anyone besides Apple.

    • Tom702
      4 out of 5 stars
      They are good but lag behind in time.
      Reviewed in the United States on August 8, 2026
      Style: 1 Pack
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I've purchased these in the past to put in numerous items including vehicles. However when placing them in vehicles i use this, "Elevation Lab Air Tag 10-Year Extended Battery - Adhesive Mount (4 Pack) | Uses AA batteries - 14x more capacity than CR2032, waterproof, CR 2032 battery replacement". This greatly extends the life of the air tag when using them in vehicles, by years!

      For those who are complaining about not being able to get the battery out and damaging the tag, you must be doing something wrong. Yes they can be a little finicky sometimes but most of mine can pretty easy. A few times I needed to use a pair of needle nosed pliers to get the battery cap off. To remove the battery cap you need to lightly push down on the cap and turn (rotate) it counterclockwise. The two times I could get the cap off I use the needle nose pliers. Just put the very end of the pliers on the sides of the cap, push down lightly and twist...walah!

      The only drawback is that they lag behind in time and/or not in real time. They may be 10, 15, 30 minutes, or even an hour behind. That is the reason for the four stars. Not really a big deal for me as I'm not using them as theft tracking devices.

      I would buy again!
